edits.old: tl.tween(taskU, 1, { at: b + 2.6, dur: 0.7, ease: ease.enter });
edits.new: tl.tween(taskU, 1, { at: b + 3.3, dur: 0.7, ease: ease.enter });

rationale: Screen y = 360 + k(y - cam.y), so CAM_WIDE y330 / CAM_BOTH y300 k1.05 pushed the RIB y528 label stack to screen 600-640, under the captions. Ribbon moves to y510 with a tighter label stack (segment labels +16, end labels +32; lowest ink at world y~573) and every full-stage camera is re-aimed so that maps to screen <=575: WIDE identity (573), RIBBON y368 k1.04 (573), BOTH y369 k1.05 (574); task chip top stays >=31 and x 60..1220 stays inside 30..1250. CAM_PAGE drops to k1.25 so the page bottom sits at 572 instead of under caption 1, and the task chip waits (3.3s) until the pull-out has it in frame. The replay chip moves into the empty band right of the page heading (world 328..561 x 146..168) and the amber question chip moves right/up (582..1058 x 458..480) because the raised ribbon heading took their old space. Cue 4: a push-in cannot hold page+lanes (1160 wide), so the page and the ribbon (new ribOp channel wrapping WorkRibbon) fade to 0 after the pause has lifted and BEFORE the camera moves; CAM_LANES then centres task chip + route A (screen x 248..1031, y 166..481); both return in beat 5 only after the pull-back is ~98% done. Cue 6: lanes fade to 0 (not 0.1) and task chip/state + ribbon fade out before CAM_FIELD starts (fades 0.1-0.7, camera 0.7-2.0); CAM_FIELD k1.28 centres page + legend (screen x 215..1065), chips at y13, page bottom 572; person tag/legend/halo start after the camera lands (1.9+), so the legend never sits over lane text and y=24 chips are never clipped mid-tween; Tab press timing unchanged. Beat 7 mirrors it: chips fade (0-0.5), camera 0.5-1.7, task/ribbon/lanes return at 1.5, route B progress shifted to start once lane B is visible (ends 3.4, meeting the unchanged next tween). Captions, narration timing, the ribbon->lift->routes->evidence-bar mechanism and all camera moves are preserved; closing panel (64..516) and RIB_CLOSE untouched, now rendered at identity.
